mapper.select: SELECT FROM AccountInviteRewards a WHERE a.ID = #{id}

select ifnull(sum(rewardsBalance),0) as total, ifnull(sum(case when date_format(FROM_UNIXTIME(createTime/1000), '%Y-%m-%d') =date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-%d') then rewardsBalance else 0 end),0) as curTotal from AccountInviteRewards

SELECT aa.id, aa.unid, aa.referralCode AS referralCode, ifnull((select sum(rewardsBalance) from AccountInviteRewards where rewardsAccountId = aa.id), 0) as total, IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT b.id), 0) AS levelOneCnt, IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 0) AS levelTwoCnt, IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT d.id), 0) AS levelThreeCnt FROM Account aa LEFT JOIN Account b ON b.referralCode = aa.invitationCode and aa.invitationCode != '' and aa.invitationCode is not null LEFT JOIN Account c ON c.referralCode = b.invitationCode and b.invitationCode != '' and b.invitationCode is not null LEFT JOIN Account d ON d.referralCode = c.invitationCode and c.invitationCode != '' and c.invitationCode is not null WHERE aa.id = #{accountId}

select ifnull(sum(rewardsBalance),0) as total, ifnull(sum(case when createTime > unix_timestamp(date(now())) * 1000 then rewardsBalance else 0 end),0) as curTotal, ifnull(sum(case when createTime > unix_timestamp(date(now())) * 1000 then 0 else rewardsBalance end),0) as hisTotal, ifnull(sum((case when registerAccountId = #{levelAccountId} then rewardsBalance else 0 end)),0) as direct, ifnull(sum((case when registerAccountId != #{levelAccountId} then rewardsBalance else 0 end)),0) as indirect from AccountInviteRewards where rewardsTag like CONCAT( '%',#{tag}, '%') AND rewardsAccountId = #{rewardsAccountId}

select aa.*, b.headUrl as headUrl, (case when trim(b.accountName)='' or b.accountName is null then b.email else b.accountName end) as email, b.createTime as registerTime from (select SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rewardsTag,#{levelAccountId} ,-1),2),',',1) as accountId, ifnull(sum(case when inviteAccountId = #{levelAccountId} then 0 else 1 end), 0) as hasInvite, ifnull(sum(rewardsBalance), 0) as total, ifnull(sum(case when createTime > unix_timestamp(date(now())) * 1000 then rewardsBalance else 0 end),0) as curTotal, ifnull(sum(case when createTime > unix_timestamp(date(now())) * 1000 then 0 else rewardsBalance end),0) as hisTotal from AccountInviteRewards where rewardsTag like CONCAT('%', #{tag}, '_%') AND rewardsAccountId = #{rewardsAccountId} group by SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rewardsTag,#{levelAccountId} ,-1),2),',',1) ) aa, Account b where aa.accountId = b.id

select ifnull(sum(rewardsBalance), 0) as totalSum, count(*) as totalCnt, ifnull(sum(case when createTime > unix_timestamp(date(now())) * 1000 then rewardsBalance else 0 end),0) as todaySum, ifnull(sum(case when createTime > unix_timestamp(date(now())) * 1000 then 1 else 0 end),0) as todayCnt from AccountInviteRewards r , (select a.id,a.email from Account a,Account b where a.referralCode=b.invitationCode and b.id=#{firstLevelAccountId}) c where r.registerAccountId = c.id and r.rewardsAccountId=#{rewardsAccountId}
